hook: India were *70/5* chasing 181. Then Hyderabad's Tilak Varma happened
tldr: Tilak Varma's unbeaten 51 off 26 and Nitish Kumar Reddy's 26 off 13 took India from 70/5 to a four-wicket win in Christchurch, with a ball to spare, for a 2-0 lead in the five-match T20I series.

beats.what: Chasing New Zealand's 180/5, India scored 68 runs in the last 4.5 overs to win the second T20I by four wickets with one ball left.
beats.why: At 135/6, India needed 46 off the last 18 balls. Tilak took 18 off the 19th over (three fours and a six); Nitish hit the winning runs.
beats.care: A Hyderabad boy finishing a chase in New Zealand. India can seal the series in the next game.

cards.body: India captain Shreyas Iyer: "Nitish and Tilak showed great character." The first match, also at Hagley Oval two days earlier, was won by four wickets too, with two balls to spare.

cards.caption: Tilak Varma off 26 balls
cards.body: He reached 50 off 25 balls (6 fours, 1 six), then finished not out.
India were 70 for 5 in the 11th over. The last 23 balls brought a 50-run stand between Tilak and Nitish.

cards.q: Best finisher in India's T20 side right now?
How many runs did India score in the last 4.5 overs?
cards.why: 68 runs from the last 4.5 overs, after being 70/5 in the 11th over (The Hindu, AFP).

viz.l: India's score at the end of overs 16–19

learn.t: A 'finisher' bats in the last overs of a chase, when the required rate is highest. Strike rate matters more than average there.

watch: Third T20I: India can seal the series. Tilak and Nitish's spots look locked.
